children.name: Collector Not Sending Data

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes 
| where _sourceCategory="collector_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<collector>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| first(_messagetime) as MostRecent, sum(bytes) as TotalVolumeBytes by collector
| formatDate(fromMillis(MostRecent),"yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss z") as MostRecentTime 
| toMillis(now()) as currentTime
| formatDate(fromMillis(currentTime),"yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss z") as SearchTime
| (currentTime-MostRecent) / 1000 / 60 as mins_since_last_logs
| where mins_since_last_logs >= 60
| fields -mostrecent, currenttime 
| format ("Collector '%s' has not collected data in the past 60 minutes", collector) as message

children.description: This hourly alert is generated when a Collector has not sent data to Sumo Logic for more than 60 minutes . The time range is the past 24 hours (-24h).

children.name: Daily Plan Limit

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="collector_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<collector>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes
| timeslice 1d
| sum(gbytes) as gbytes by _timeslice
| 1 as daily_plan_size // Replace the 1 with your daily plan limit in GB found by going to Administration > Account > Account Overview
| where gbytes >= daily_plan_size
| sort gbytes
| fields _timeslice, gbytes, daily_plan_size

children.description:
This daily alert is generated when when yesterday's daily account ingest greater than your daily plan limit. 

**You must replace the X in the search for the search to be successfully run

children.name: Indexes with Zero Ingest

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory = "view_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<view_name>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| where (view_name not in ("Default Index", "sumologic_volume", "sumologic_audit")) and !(view_name matches "_sumologic_report_*")
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes
| sum(gbytes) as gbytes by view_name
| where gbytes = 0
| sort by view_name asc

children.description: This query will help identify indexes (views and partitions) not receiving ingest in specified time range.

children.name: Ingest Spike

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="sourcecategory_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<sourceCategory>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes
| timeslice 1d
| sum(gbytes) as gbytes by _timeslice
| sort by _timeslice asc 
| smooth gbytes, 30 as moving_avg // 30 days moving average - user can customize this value.
| gbytes as curr_day_gbytes
| 50 as spikePercentThreshold // With what percent of ingest spike user would like to have alert - user can customize this value.
| where curr_day_gbytes >= (1 + spikePercentThreshold / 100) * moving_avg
| sort by _timeslice | limit 1
| Now() - _timeslice as timediff | (timediff/3600000) as timediff
| 25 as timeThreshold // User would like to know what happened in last 25 hours
| where timediff <= timeThreshold
| fields -gbytes, spikePercentThreshold, timediff, timeThreshold
// Schedule this search once a day with time range of 60 days (double of what user like to have moving average for). Set condition to alert if there are more than 0 records in the result

children.description: Alert if current ingest is 50% more than moving average.

children.name: Ingest Spike by sourceCategory

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="sourcecategory_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<sourceCategory>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes
| timeslice 1d
| sum(gbytes) as gbytes by _timeslice, sourceCategory
| sort by _timeslice asc 
| smooth gbytes, 30 as moving_avg by sourceCategory // 30 days moving average for specific sourceCategory - user can customize this value.
| gbytes as curr_day_gbytes
| 50 as spikePercentThreshold // With what percent of ingest spike user would like to have alert - user can customize this value.
| where curr_day_gbytes >= (1 + spikePercentThreshold / 100) * moving_avg
| Now() - _timeslice as timediff | (timediff/3600000) as timediff
| 25 as timeThreshold // User would like to know what happened in last 25 hours
| where timediff <= timeThreshold
| fields -gbytes, spikePercentThreshold, timediff, timeThreshold
// Schedule this search once a day with time range of 60 days (double of what user like to have moving average for). Set condition to alert if there are more than 0 records in the result

children.description: Alert if current ingest for specific sourceCategory is 50% more than moving average.

children.name: Message Size, BoxPlot by Source Category

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="sourcecategory_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<sourcecategory>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| bytes/count as permessage
| min(permessage), pct(permessage,25), pct(permessage,50), pct(permessage,75), max(permessage), count by sourcecategory

children.name: Monthly Plan Limit

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="collector_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<collector>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| timeslice 1d
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes 
| sum(gbytes) as gbytes by _timeslice 
| formatDate(_timeslice, "YY") as year
| formatDate(_timeslice, "MM") as month
| number(month)
| formatDate(_timeslice, "dd") as day
| number(day)
| formatDate(now(), "MM") as current_month
| number(current_month)
| formatDate(now(), "dd") as current_day
| number(current_day)
| 1 as billing_start // Replace the 1 with your billing start day which can be found in Administration > Account > Account Overview.
| 28 as billing_end // Replace the 28 with your billing end day which can be found in Administration > Account > Account Overview
| if(current_day < billing_start, current_month-1, current_month) as start_month
| if(billing_start=1 && billing_end=31, current_month, if(current_day >= billing_start, current_month+1, current_month)) as end_month
| if(((month>start_month AND day<=billing_end) OR (month=start_month AND day>=billing_start)), "true", "false") as include
| 1 as day_count
| if(start_month in(1,3,5,7,8,10,12), 31, if (start_month in(4,6,9,11), 30, if(year % 4 == 0, 29, 28))) as days_in_start_month
| if(end_month in(1,3,5,7,8,10,12), 31, if (end_month in(4,6,9,11), 30, if(year % 4 == 0, 29, 28))) as days_in_end_month
| where include="true"
| order by _timeslice
| sum(gbytes) as gbytes, sum(day_count) as day_count, max(current_month) as current_month, max(current_day) as current_day, max(days_in_start_month) as days_in_start_month, max(days_in_end_month) as days_in_end_month, max(start_month) as start_month, max(end_month) as end_month, max(billing_start) as billing_start, max(billing_end) as billing_end
| if(current_month = end_month, billing_end-current_day, if(current_month < end_month, days_in_start_month-current_day+billing_end, 0)) as billing_days_remaining
| 1 as daily_gb_limit // Replace the 1 with your ingest limit per day which can be found in Administration > Account > Account Overview
| daily_gb_limit * (day_count + billing_days_remaining) as expected_ingest_in_billing_cycle
| (gbytes/expected_ingest_in_billing_cycle) * 100 as pct_used
| where pct_used > 85

children.description: This daily alert is generated when total ingest for the current billing period is greater than or equal to 85% of your total Sumo Logic monthly plan limit.   The alert covers the past 32 days (-32d).**You must replace the X in the search for the search to be successfully run

children.name: Over Daily Capacity For Last 3 Days

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="sourcecategory_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<sourcecategory>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes 
| timeslice 1d
| sum(gbytes) as daily_ingest_gbytes by _timeslice
| 150 as avg_daily_ingest_capacity // This is account contract based value. Customize this value. Can be found in Administration > Account > Account Overview
| where daily_ingest_gbytes >= avg_daily_ingest_capacity
| Now() - _timeslice as timediff | (timediff/(3600000*24)) as timediff
| 3 as timeThreshold // User would like to know what happened in last 3 days. It is assumed that user would like to alert if ingest for last 3 days is Over daily capacity
| where timediff <= timeThreshold 
| fields -timediff, timeThreshold
// Schedule this search once a day with time range of 3 days. Set condition to alert if there are 3 (keep this value same as timeThreshold) records

children.description: Alert if ingest for each of the last 3 days is more than average daily ingest capacity as per subscription contract

children.name: sourceCategory Ingest Spike

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="sourcecategory_volume" 
| parse regex "\"(?<sourcecategory>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes
| timeslice 1h
| sum(gbytes) as gbytes by sourcecategory, _timeslice
| where !(sourceCategory matches "*_volume")
| compare timeshift -1w 4 max 
| ((gbytes - gbytes_4w_max) / gbytes) * 100 as pct_increase
| total gbytes by _timeslice
| (gbytes / _total) * 100 as ingest_weight 
| where pct_increase  > 50 and ingest_weight > 25

children.description:
This hourly alert is generated when both of the following occur:
1) Ingest for any _sourceCategory in your account has a 50% spike compared with the maximum ingest for the same _sourceCategory over the last four weeks (comparison is with the same hour and day of week).
2) The volume ingested by the _sourceCategory represents at least 25 % of the total data ingested within the hour.
